draft_text: Thornbill-NER is robust to label noise: its F1 drop stayed within the pre-specified criterion at 10%, 20% and 30% noise (0.6, 1.3 and 1.8 points).
rationale: The package only reports exp1 on original labels (T1). No noise conditions, no F1 drops, no T2 table exist. The claimed 0.6/1.3/1.8 point drops and 10/20/30% noise are entirely absent from the evidence.
